title: Junior Snowboard Rental Package for Snowbasin and Powder Mountain
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Riders must have a shoe size 6 or under to be accommodated with this package regardless of age
You are permitted to pick up your gear the night before you ski after 4pm, so you can enjoy a full day on the slopes. You have until 10:00 am the day after your final ski day to return the gear.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Young ones of all abilities can enjoy the slopes with this Junior Snowboard Package. Rental period is 24 hours, leaving you plenty of time to enjoy the snow.
